title: Kashtiliash
summary: Kassite king of Babylon defeated by Tukulti-Ninurta I.
description: Kassite king of Babylon defeated by Tukulti-Ninurta I. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (1232 B.C.). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "5. Kassites 576 y minus 50 to death of Kashtiliash"
death.note: CFAH pegs "the defeat of Kashtiliash I in 1232 B.C." to Tukulti-Ninurta I's conquest of Babylon (first as a thought experiment, then noted as fitting "to the year").

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 5 "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Kassite Dynasty", p. 58

free_source_links.locator: "5. Kassites 576 y minus 50 to death of Kashtiliash"
